mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stock_watch_delivery_config (symbol, market, stock_name, enabled, recipients_json, sender_mode, frequency_type, interval_minutes, trigger_policy_json, active_from, last_dispatch_status, last_dispatch_message) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{market}, #{stockName}, #{enabled}, #{recipientsJson}, #{senderMode}, #{frequencyType}, #{intervalMinutes}, #{triggerPolicyJson}, #{activeFrom}, #{lastDispatchStatus}, #{lastDispatchMessage})
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_delivery_config SET stock_name = #{stockName}, enabled = #{enabled}, recipients_json = #{recipientsJson}, sender_mode = #{senderMode}, frequency_type = #{frequencyType}, interval_minutes = #{intervalMinutes}, trigger_policy_json = #{triggerPolicyJson}, active_from = #{activeFrom}, last_dispatch_status = #{lastDispatchStatus}, last_dispatch_message = #{lastDispatchMessage} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM stock_watch_delivery_config WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY gmt_modify DESC, id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE stock_watch_delivery_config SET last_dispatch_status = #{status}, last_dispatch_message = #{message}, last_dispatch_at = CASE WHEN #{dispatchAt} IS NULL THEN last_dispatch_at ELSE #{dispatchAt} END WHERE id = #{id}
